cases.title: Repository aggregate deterministic suite
cases.task: Run every offline suite the repository already ships (18 named suites).
cases.expected_outcome: All embedded suites pass with no model, network or install step.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 0 and the final 'SELF-TEST PASS' marker.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Full stdout tail plus the final marker.

cases.title: Runtime controller self-test
cases.task: Drive the 125-case runtime lifetime suite (state, gates, repairs, review, routing).
cases.evaluation_method: Parse 'PASS n/n' from stdout.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio and command line.

cases.title: Context transport self-test
cases.task: Drive the 50-case packet/context compiler suite (staleness, tamper, isolation).
cases.expected_outcome: 50/50 pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse 'PASS n/n' from stdout.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio and command line.

cases.title: Reasoner adapter self-test
cases.task: Validate provider contract, capability evidence classes and fallback rules.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse 'PASS n/n' from stdout.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio.

cases.title: Repository contract checks
cases.task: Run the 18 repository contract checks (links, distribution, policies, prompts).
cases.expected_outcome: Every check prints ok and the run ends with PASS.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 0, zero FAIL lines, final PASS.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Check count and final marker.

cases.title: Validation-instrument guard self-test
cases.task: Prove every measurement guard in the run-record validator can actually fail.
cases.expected_outcome: All guards fire on broken input.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse 'PASS n guards'.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Guard count and result.

cases.title: Installed-product lifecycle suite
cases.task: Install/update/rollback/doctor/uninstall lifecycle against local bundles.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse closing 'PASS n/n'.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio.

cases.title: Release bundle self-test
cases.task: Verify manifest hashing, allowlist contents and offline determinism.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse closing 'PASS n/n'.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio.

cases.title: Real-project fixture self-test
cases.task: Drive the five v1.5 real-project archetypes through the runtime structures.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse closing 'PASS n/n'.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio.

cases.title: Social-intelligence fixture self-test
cases.task: Drive the five social archetypes through the creative-operations structures.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse closing 'PASS n/n'.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio.

cases.title: Reasoner rollback across two release bundles
cases.task: Verify reasoner switching/rollback semantics across an upgrade between two built bundles.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse closing 'PASS n/n'.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio.
cases.notes: Requires two built release bundles (--baseline-bundle/--current-bundle); not executable in AR-200. The reasoner-switch path itself is covered by suite.runtime-self-test.

cases.title: Writing-contract self-test
cases.task: Verify the writing intent contracts are structurally complete.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 0.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code and tail.

cases.title: Writing-execution self-test
cases.task: Verify writing execution paths and hard rules.
cases.expected_outcome: All cases pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 0.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code and tail.

cases.title: Existing validation-run measurement
cases.task: Read the recorded B1 validation run through the validator's benchmark mode.
cases.expected_outcome: At least one run is read and reported without error.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 0 and a non-empty run table.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Run table tail.

cases.title: Start creates one verified S1 packet
cases.task: Start a run and inspect the state, packet and manifest.
cases.expected_outcome: State schema 1, single S1 packet, packet verifies against its manifest, no gate granted.
cases.evaluation_method: Read state/manifest; run TRANSPORT.verify_packet.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: State keys, packet path, verify result, gate field.

cases.title: Duplicate run is refused
cases.task: Start twice into the same run root.
cases.expected_outcome: Second start exits non-zero and does not overwrite the first run.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare exit code and state packet count.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes and refusal message.

cases.title: Incomplete brief cannot advance
cases.task: Run advance at S1 without the brief documents.
cases.expected_outcome: Exit 2, no stage evidence written, missing outputs named.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code plus absence of stage-result.json.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, message, evidence directory listing.

cases.title: Completed brief prepares S3
cases.task: Record S1 outputs and let the runtime choose the next boundary.
cases.expected_outcome: A verified S3 packet is prepared automatically.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code plus last packet stage.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Stage of last packet and verify result.

cases.title: S3 cannot reach the build boundary without a human G1 record
cases.task: Advance from S3 while DESIGN.md only holds a draft direction.
cases.expected_outcome: Exit non-zero, no S4A packet, and the runtime names the missing human decision.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code, packet stages and the recorded next action.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Stage list and the reason the runtime recorded.

cases.title: Locked G1 direction prepares S4A
cases.task: Write the locked direction and the recorded gate, then continue.
cases.expected_outcome: S4A packet prepared and the human creative decision marked resolved.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code, last stage, intervention status.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Stage list and intervention status.

cases.title: Implementation boundary requires provider preflight
cases.task: Prepare the build boundary without recording provider/model readiness.
cases.expected_outcome: Continuation pauses with a named preflight reason; no S4B packet.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code and last packet stage.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pause reason and stage list.

cases.title: S4B packet carries worker contract and repository baseline
cases.task: Clear preflight and prepare the implementation packet.
cases.expected_outcome: Packet has a worker role, bounded repair limit, unique in-project return target and a git baseline.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect manifest fields and verify_packet.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Worker block, return target, baseline head.

cases.title: Blocked worker return stops without an automatic retry
cases.task: Deliver a blocked implementation return and run advance.
cases.expected_outcome: Exit 2, no new packet, a blocked-return record in the operations log.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code, packet count, log text.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Log line and stage list.

cases.title: Independent validation executes the declared commands
cases.task: Deliver a complete return and let Ariadne validate it independently.
cases.expected_outcome: validation.json records real command executions with return codes and hashes.
cases.evaluation_method: Read validation evidence and compare command ids with HANDOFF.md.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Command records with returncode, stdout hash, scope status.

cases.title: Repair budget stays bounded
cases.task: Attempt to widen the worker repair limit beyond the contract maximum.
cases.expected_outcome: The transport rejects a repair limit above MAX_ROUTINE_REPAIRS.
cases.evaluation_method: Mutate the S4B manifest in the sandbox and re-verify.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Verifier problem string and contract constant.

cases.title: S5 packet is the canonical isolated pair
cases.task: Validate a complete return and let the runtime prepare the review boundary.
cases.expected_outcome: S5 delivers only the current prompt block and EVALUATION-RUBRICS.md; no project or build context.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect delivered source labels and forbidden kinds.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Delivered labels list and verifier result.

cases.title: Acceptance requires review evidence and the recorded human gate
cases.task: Attempt to accept a worker result with no independent review and no G3 record.
cases.expected_outcome: Acceptance is refused; no acceptance state is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 1 and worker acceptance_state unchanged.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal message and worker state.

cases.title: Telemetry never invents usage or cost
cases.task: Run a worker cycle and read worker-telemetry.jsonl.
cases.expected_outcome: Usage and cost remain the literal string 'unknown' when the provider did not report them.
cases.evaluation_method: Scan telemetry rows for missing or fabricated numeric usage.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Event names and usage/cost values.

cases.title: Unknown run-state schema is refused, not migrated
cases.task: Bump the sandboxed run-state schema_version and read status.
cases.expected_outcome: The runtime refuses the state instead of guessing or migrating.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code and refusal message.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Message text and exit code.

cases.title: Changed project input invalidates a prepared packet
cases.task: Modify a delivered project input after packet preparation.
cases.expected_outcome: Packet verification reports the stale source; strict consumption refuses.
cases.evaluation_method: Run verify_packet and a strict current_packet read.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Verifier problems and refusal message.

cases.title: Gate approval requires an out-of-band human record
cases.task: Play the role of an actor with ordinary write access and CLI access: write the locked direction and the gate field into the two project documents, record the stage result, then continue. No human decision is ever supplied.
cases.expected_outcome: An agent-writable project document must not be sufficient to grant a human gate.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the continuation and observe whether G1 is treated as granted.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, resulting stage, and the exact documents that were sufficient.

cases.title: Creative-evidence gate holds on every continuation path
cases.task: At S3 with a locked direction and no recorded creative evidence, compare three continuation paths: advance without a recorded stage result, advance after recording one, and prepare-next.
cases.expected_outcome: Every continuation path enforces the same creative-evidence requirement.
cases.evaluation_method: Run each path in its own sandbox and compare exit codes and resulting stages.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, stages and messages for all three paths.

cases.title: Review independence is a recorded identity, not a self-written attestation
cases.task: Ingest a review judgement with no reviewer identity, with the implementation worker's own identity, with the attestation line removed, and finally with an independent identity.
cases.expected_outcome: Independence comes from a recorded reviewer identity bound to the reviewed revision; a self-written attestation field and the implementer's own identity must not satisfy it.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare ingestion exit codes across the four variants and inspect the stored review record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, the accepted fields, and the stored review record.

cases.title: Sensitive path writes are blocked at validation
cases.task: Have the worker create .env inside the project, then validate.
cases.expected_outcome: Validation blocks with a dangerous-action classification and no pass.
cases.evaluation_method: Read validation.json status and failure_kind.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Status, failure kind and the offending path.

cases.title: Out-of-contract writes are blocked at validation
cases.task: Have the worker modify a file that HANDOFF.md scope does not permit.
cases.expected_outcome: Validation blocks with an out-of-scope classification.
cases.evaluation_method: Read validation.json scope status and changed paths.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Scope status, changed list, exit code.

cases.title: Immutable worker contract cannot change mid-attempt
cases.task: Modify HANDOFF.md after the S4B packet was prepared, then validate.
cases.expected_outcome: Validation blocks as a repository conflict and names HANDOFF.md.
cases.evaluation_method: Read validation.json status, failure_kind and immutable list.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Failure kind and immutable paths.

cases.title: Recorded evidence cannot be overwritten
cases.task: Ingest the same worker return and validation twice.
cases.expected_outcome: The second write is refused for both return and validation evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare exit codes and file hashes across attempts.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both refusal messages and the unchanged hash.

cases.title: Tampered packet is detected, not trusted
cases.task: Edit the prepared packet text after preparation and re-verify.
cases.expected_outcome: Packet hash mismatch is reported and the run refuses to continue.
cases.evaluation_method: Verify the packet, then attempt a continuation.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Verifier problem and refusal exit code.

cases.title: Declined conditional inputs are recorded as omitted
cases.task: Prepare S3 with --motion no --assets no and inspect the manifest.
cases.expected_outcome: Motion/asset policies are omitted with a recorded reason and never delivered.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the manifest omitted list and packet body.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Omitted entries and absence from the packet.

cases.title: Triggered conditional inputs are delivered and hash-stamped
cases.task: Prepare S3 with --motion yes and inspect delivered sources.
cases.expected_outcome: DESIGN-MOTION.md is delivered with a matching SOURCE-SHA256 header.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the header hash with the canonical file hash.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Header line and computed hash.

cases.title: Creative evidence from another project is refused
cases.task: Write a creative ledger that names a different project, then prepare S3.
cases.expected_outcome: Preparation refuses with an explicit ownership error.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code and message.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal text and ledger identity.

cases.title: Every delivered source hash matches its canonical bytes
cases.task: Prepare S1 and S3 packets and compare every manifest source hash to the file.
cases.expected_outcome: All delivered source hashes match; the packet contains exactly the declared sections.
cases.evaluation_method: Recompute hashes for all sources and run verify_packet.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Per-source comparison and verifier result.

cases.title: Packet size baseline per stage
cases.task: Measure delivered context bytes for S1 and S3 under a fixed fixture.
cases.expected_outcome: Measurement-only: record bytes, sources and omitted inputs for later comparison.
cases.evaluation_method: Sum packet.txt bytes and count delivered sources.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Per-stage byte counts and source counts.

cases.title: Creative planning requires a completed brief
cases.task: Attempt creative planning before the brief exists.
cases.expected_outcome: Refused; no ledger written.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code and absence of creative-evidence.json.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal message.

cases.title: Unsupported creative claims block the G1 presentation
cases.task: Reach S3 with a design direction but no creative plan or skill evidence, then advance.
cases.expected_outcome: Exit 2 with an unsupported-claim reason and no G1 request.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code and message.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Message text and intervention state.

cases.title: Implementation targets are derived from the approved direction
cases.task: Prepare the S4B packet and inspect the creative-operations ledger.
cases.expected_outcome: A ledger of approved requirements is derived from DESIGN.md/HANDOFF.md without another human task.
cases.evaluation_method: Read creative-operations.json and its requirement ids.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Requirement ids and the log line that records the derivation.

cases.title: Release manifest validation rejects incomplete metadata
cases.task: Feed the release-manifest validator malformed and truncated manifests.
cases.expected_outcome: Missing files, bad hashes, wrong product/schema and absent compatibility range are rejected.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the validator directly with mutated manifests and assert each mutation fails.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Per-mutation problem lists.

cases.title: Version and project-state schema stay in lockstep
cases.task: Compare VERSION, pyproject metadata, the run-state schema and the declared compatibility range.
cases.expected_outcome: One version authority; declared project-state range matches the runtime's accepted schema.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the files and the runtime constant, and compare.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Version strings and schema numbers.

cases.title: Release and runtime tooling stay offline and dependency-free
cases.task: Statistically scan the shipped scripts and the build backend for network or third-party imports.
cases.expected_outcome: No network client imports in release/runtime tooling; no declared dependencies.
cases.evaluation_method: Parse imports with ast across shipped Python files.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Import inventory per file.

cases.title: Rollback and uninstall keep hard safety guards
cases.task: Drive an installed-product lifecycle in a sandboxed data home using a local bundle.
cases.expected_outcome: Rollback restores a verified previous runtime; uninstall refuses a dangerous root.
cases.evaluation_method: Reuse the shipped lifecycle suite output for the guarded paths.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Suite pass ratio for the lifecycle group.
cases.notes: Covered by suite.distribution-lifecycle; kept as an explicit distribution contract case.

cases.title: Wheel build and isolated install
cases.task: Build the launcher wheel and install it into a throwaway venv.
cases.expected_outcome: Wheel builds offline, installs, and the installed launcher runs.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code of the shipped wheel suite.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Pass ratio and venv path.
cases.notes: Requires a working pip/venv and is slow; not executed during AR-200 (see BENCHMARKS.md).

cases.title: Orchestration-core self-test
cases.task: Exercise the AR-201 contracts, transition choke point, approval binding, review records, migration and API in isolated temporary directories.
cases.expected_outcome: All engine-core checks pass with no model call and no network.
cases.evaluation_method: Exit code 0 from scripts/test-engine-core.py.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code and tail.

cases.title: A semantic edit invalidates a recorded approval
cases.task: Reach S3 with the direction evidence and a recorded G1 approval, edit the design thesis, then continue to S4A.
cases.expected_outcome: The approval no longer binds the new revision and the continuation is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the exit code, the recorded approval and the refusal reason.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, approval fingerprint, refusal message.

cases.title: A non-human approval channel cannot satisfy a gate
cases.task: Write an approval record for G1 carrying a worker channel and a worker identity into the run state by hand, then continue to S4A.
cases.expected_outcome: The gate stays unsatisfied: only the human CLI channel grants authority.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the refusal reason and confirm no S4A packet was prepared.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, refusal reason, recorded channels.

cases.title: The transition table refuses illegal jumps and never half-applies them
cases.task: Call the engine's transition choke point directly with an illegal stage jump and with a refused worker transition.
cases.expected_outcome: Illegal transitions raise structured errors and leave the state unchanged.
cases.evaluation_method: Catch InvalidTransition/PolicyRefusal and compare the state before and after.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exception types, state digests before and after.

cases.title: Legacy run state needs an explicit, additive, reversible migration
cases.task: Strip the engine contract from a copy of a live run state, then read it without and with --migrate, and repeat the migration.
cases.expected_outcome: Reading refuses with an explicit instruction; migration preserves the original file, records history, invents no approval and is idempotent.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare exit codes, the preserved backup, the migration history and the approval count.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, backup bytes, migration history, approvals.

cases.title: The protected slice works through the Python API
cases.task: Drive start, record-result, prepare-next, approve-gate and status through ENGINE_API with no subprocess, and check the reported state changes.
cases.expected_outcome: Every API call returns the documented exit code and the run reaches the approved boundary, with refusals reported as results rather than exceptions.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare API exit codes, messages and Result.state_changed against the run state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: API results, resulting stages, recorded approvals.

cases.title: An approval for one target or operation cannot authorize another
cases.task: Record a G1 approval, then present it as a G2 handoff approval and as an approval for a different design revision.
cases.expected_outcome: Each mismatch is refused and named.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the gate checks for wrong operation, wrong target and wrong revision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal reasons for each mismatch.

cases.title: Acceptance needs the recorded review and spends the G3 approval once
cases.task: Reach S5, ingest an independent review, record the human G3 approval, accept the result and then repeat the accepted outcome.
cases.expected_outcome: Acceptance succeeds once with the bound approval; the replay is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare exit codes, lifecycle states and the consumed approval record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, worker lifecycle, approval consumption.

cases.title: A review judgement on disk is not a review record
cases.task: Write a convincing review judgement into the S5 evidence directory by hand, then try to approve G3 and accept the result.
cases.expected_outcome: Neither the gate nor acceptance can be obtained without a recorded review bound to the revision.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the exit codes and the stored review records.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, review records, acceptance state.

cases.title: Migration never converts a document gate field into an approval
cases.task: Migrate a legacy run whose AGENTS.md records G1 and whose DESIGN.md is locked, then continue.
cases.expected_outcome: The run keeps no approval and must re-obtain the human gate.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the approvals after migration and the continuation exit code.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Migration history, approval count, exit code.

cases.title: Interrupted work is reported, never adopted or inferred as success
cases.task: Leave an orphan packet directory and an interrupted state write beside a live run, then inspect recovery state and continue normally.
cases.expected_outcome: Recovery names the divergence, adopts nothing, and the run keeps working.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the recovery report and the packet list before and after.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Recovery report, packet list, continuation exit code.

cases.title: Every candidate source has an inclusion decision with a machine-readable reason
cases.task: Prepare S3 and read the recorded context decision beside the delivered manifest.
cases.expected_outcome: Required sources are included with reasons; each decision is structurally valid and bound to the packet.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the state's context decision with the manifest's delivered sources.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Context decision record, manifest context_decision block, packet section list.

cases.title: An optional source the task does not need is omitted with a reason
cases.task: Prepare S3 for a run that declares it does not require creative evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: The optional creative ledger is omitted as irrelevant, required sources are unchanged.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the omission reason and confirm the ledger is absent from the packet.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Decision entry, packet body, delivered source list.

cases.title: A retry with unchanged canonical inputs reuses recorded source hashes
cases.task: Prepare S4B, then escalate to a second attempt without changing any delivered source.
cases.expected_outcome: The second decision records cache hits and the packet still verifies.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the second context decision and the cache-hit events; re-verify the packet.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Context decision cache block, engine events, packet verification.

cases.title: An edited source is re-derived and the stale hash is not reused
cases.task: Prepare S4B, edit a delivered project source, then prepare the next attempt.
cases.expected_outcome: The edited source is recorded as invalidated and the packet carries the new hash.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the recorded invalidation, the packet header hash and the current file hash.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Invalidation event, packet source header, file hash.

cases.title: Adaptive context cannot surface a forbidden source at S5
cases.task: Reach the isolated review boundary on a run with a populated context cache.
cases.expected_outcome: S5 delivers only the canonical pair; no cached or project source is included.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect delivered labels, the decision record and the packet body.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Delivered labels, decision entries, packet inspection.

cases.title: Measured preparation, decision and detection cost (observed, never judged)
cases.task: Repeat a deterministic packet preparation with and without an adaptive plan and cache reuse.
cases.expected_outcome: Recorded numbers only: medians and ranges for preparation, decisions and detection.
cases.evaluation_method: No pass/fail judgement; the case reports measured medians and ranges.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Timing samples, delivered bytes, source counts, cache-hit bytes.

cases.title: A low-difficulty task routes to the sufficient light strategy
cases.task: Prepare the S4B boundary for a small typographic experiment.
cases.expected_outcome: The routing decision selects the declared bulk role and records it as sufficient.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the recorded routing decision and the packet's worker contract.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Routing decision record, packet worker role, engine events.

cases.title: A high-difficulty, high-stakes task records that the declared role is insufficient
cases.task: Start a run whose request declares a production authentication migration, then prepare S4B.
cases.expected_outcome: Characterisation raises difficulty/stakes and the route records the missing capability.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the characterisation, the excluded candidate and the chosen verdict.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Characterisation record, routing decision exclusions.

cases.title: Escalation selects the lightest stronger sufficient candidate
cases.task: Escalate the S4B boundary after the first attempt.
cases.expected_outcome: The new packet names a stronger worker role and the decision records the escalation rule.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the packet worker role with the routing decision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Routing decision, packet manifest worker role, packet list.

cases.title: An authorization failure stops routing instead of being worked around
cases.task: Produce a blocked out-of-contract validation, then try to escalate past it.
cases.expected_outcome: The escalation is refused with an authorization reason and no packet is created.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the exit code, the packet list and the recorded routing decision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, packet count, routing decision or pause message.

cases.title: A missing human gate is never routed around
cases.task: Ask for the S4A boundary before G1 is recorded, with an explicit stage argument.
cases.expected_outcome: The boundary is refused and no packet, route or approval is invented.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the packet list, routing decisions and approvals before and after.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, packet list, routing decision count, approval count.

cases.title: A worker runtime claim is recorded as reported identity, never as observed
cases.task: Deliver an implementation return whose provider and model differ from the request.
cases.expected_outcome: The mismatch is recorded and observed identity stays UNKNOWN.
cases.evaluation_method: Read return-handoff.json execution block and the engine events.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Machine return record, engine events, execution record.

cases.title: A pinned model identity refuses a mismatched execution
cases.task: Declare a concrete model, then deliver a return that reports a different one.
cases.expected_outcome: The return is refused with an identity reason and no state advances.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the exit code and the refusal message.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, refusal text, state before/after.

cases.title: The prepared boundary owns an engine-created execution identity
cases.task: Prepare S4B and inspect the execution record and operator status command.
cases.expected_outcome: The identity is engine-generated, bound to the packet and revision, and observed identity is UNKNOWN.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the run state execution record and the execution-status output.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Execution record, status output, structural validation.

cases.title: A forged, foreign or replayed execution identity is refused
cases.task: Submit results naming an unknown execution, another task's execution and a finished execution.
cases.expected_outcome: Each attempt is refused and only the engine-created identity is accepted.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the refusals, the engine verification and the recorded execution state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, refusal messages, engine verification results.

cases.title: A review binds the implementation and review executions separately
cases.task: Reach S5, try to review as the implementing execution, then record a real review.
cases.expected_outcome: Binding the implementer as reviewer is refused; the recorded review names two distinct executions.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the refusal, the review record and the run state executions.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal message, review record, execution records.

cases.title: An execution bound to another revision cannot deliver a result
cases.task: Prepare S4B, move the project revision on, then deliver the recorded return.
cases.expected_outcome: The engine refuses the result as bound to a different revision.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the execution revision, the current packet revision and the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Execution revision, packet revision, refusal message.

cases.title: A recoverable orphan packet is adopted through the engine boundary
cases.task: Simulate a crash between writing the S3 packet and recording its transition, then recover.
cases.expected_outcome: The orphan is reported, adopted only with an operator identity and reason, and the pre-recovery state is preserved.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect the report, the applied recovery record, the transition and the backup bytes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Recovery report, recovery record, transition, backup digest.

cases.title: An ambiguous orphan packet is refused rather than adopted
cases.task: Leave a packet directory whose recorded parent is not the current tip and try to adopt it.
cases.expected_outcome: Recovery refuses with a reason and changes nothing.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the refusal, the packet list and the recovery records.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal message, packet list, recovery records.

cases.title: An open execution that cannot finish is recorded as interrupted
cases.task: Prepare an S4B attempt, escalate past it, then recover the stranded execution.
cases.expected_outcome: The stranded execution is reported and abandoned with class INTERRUPTED, not as success.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the findings, the recovery record, the execution state and the failure class.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Recovery report, recovery record, execution state, failure record.

cases.title: A leftover temporary state file is quarantined, not deleted silently
cases.task: Leave an interrupted state write beside a live run and recover it.
cases.expected_outcome: The file is reported, moved to quarantine with its digest recorded, and the live state is untouched.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the live state bytes, the quarantine location and the recorded evidence.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Recovery record, quarantine path, state digest before and after.

cases.title: S4B is refused when the S4A planning work has no recorded evidence
cases.task: Reach S4A with a complete handoff but without recording the implementation-planning skill.
cases.expected_outcome: The boundary is refused with the exact evidence requirement and no packet is created.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the exit code, the pause message and the packet list.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, refusal message, packet list, requirement states.

cases.title: S5 is refused when the S4B QA work has no recorded evidence
cases.task: Validate a complete implementation return without recording the QA skill or the implementation trace.
cases.expected_outcome: The review boundary is refused with the evidence requirement named.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the exit code, the pause message and the requirement states.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, refusal message, requirement states.

cases.title: Evidence whose artifact changed after it was recorded is refused as stale
cases.task: Record the S4A planning evidence, then change the artifact it names.
cases.expected_outcome: The boundary is refused as stale instead of accepting the recorded claim.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the artifact digest with the recorded evidence digest.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code, stale requirement detail, artifact digests.

cases.title: Satisfied evidence lets the same boundaries proceed
cases.task: Record the S4A planning evidence, the S4B QA evidence and the implementation trace, then continue.
cases.expected_outcome: Every requirement is satisfied and both boundaries are prepared.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the requirement states and the prepared stages.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Requirement states, packet stages.

cases.title: A backend task selects no design work at all
cases.task: Characterise a database migration and API endpoint against a backend handoff.
cases.expected_outcome: design_task is NOT_REQUIRED, the depth is NONE, and every design stage is SKIPPED.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the real characterisation and pipeline selection; check the recorded values.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The characterisation record and its selected pipeline.

cases.title: A copy change is not automatically a high-depth design task
cases.task: Characterise a headline copy update and inspect the selected depth.
cases.expected_outcome: The task is not DEEP, and no reference research is required.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the characterisation and the selected pipeline depth.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The characterisation record.

cases.title: A new landing page selects reference research and rendered observation
cases.task: Characterise a new landing page that explicitly asks for reference research.
cases.expected_outcome: RETRIEVE, INSPECT, ANALYSE, OBSERVE and CRITIQUE are selected, never SKIPPED.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the selected pipeline for the characterisation.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The selected pipeline stages and their reasons.

cases.title: A tiny spacing fix does not trigger broad reference research
cases.task: Characterise a one-file spacing tweak and inspect the selected stages.
cases.expected_outcome: RETRIEVE, INSPECT and ANALYSE are SKIPPED and the depth is MINIMAL.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the selected pipeline for the characterisation.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The selected pipeline stages.

cases.title: Front-end code in the repository is not evidence about the task
cases.task: Put front-end files in the project, then characterise a backend task.
cases.expected_outcome: design_task stays NOT_REQUIRED: repository contents never raise design depth.
cases.evaluation_method: Create front-end files, characterise a backend request, read the characteristics.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The characterisation and the project files that were ignored.

cases.title: Accessibility and responsive review are raised by the request, with evidence
cases.task: Characterise an accessible, responsive checkout form request.
cases.expected_outcome: Both characteristics are REQUIRED and each records the evidence that raised it.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the two characteristics and their evidence lists.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The characterisation characteristics and their evidence.

cases.title: A found reference is not an inspected reference
cases.task: Record a reference as found, then attempt an analysis without an inspection.
cases.expected_outcome: The analysis is refused: a found URL carries no content claim.
cases.evaluation_method: Record found, attempt analysis, read the refusal and the unchanged state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the reference state.

cases.title: An inaccessible source never becomes an inspected source
cases.task: Record a reference as inaccessible, then attempt to inspect it.
cases.expected_outcome: The inspection is refused and the record stays INACCESSIBLE with its blocker.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the blocker, attempt an inspection, read the refusal and the record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the terminal record with its blocker.

cases.title: An inspection requires a real evidence artifact
cases.task: Attempt a visual inspection whose evidence file does not exist.
cases.expected_outcome: Only the inspection without evidence is refused; the one with evidence is accepted.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt both inspections and compare their outcomes and the recorded artifact hash.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the accepted record and its artifact digest.

cases.title: An analysis must derive from an inspection that happened
cases.task: Analyse an inspected reference, citing an inspection id this reference does not have.
cases.expected_outcome: The fabricated citation is refused; the real inspection id is accepted.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt both analyses and read the refusals and the recorded derived_from list.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the recorded analysis.

cases.title: A reference cannot be used before it is analysed
cases.task: Attempt to mark an inspected-but-unanalysed reference as used, then complete the chain.
cases.expected_outcome: USED requires ANALYSIS; the full chain succeeds and records the artifact anchor.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt used early, then run accessible/inspect/analyse/use and read the record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The early refusal and the completed usage record.

cases.title: A changed artifact invalidates the inspection recorded from it
cases.task: Inspect a reference against its artifact, then modify the artifact.
cases.expected_outcome: The provenance check reports the artifact changed after evidence was recorded.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the engine provenance check before and after modifying the artifact.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The provenance problem list before and after the edit.

cases.title: A content inspection cannot support a visual claim
cases.task: Record a content inspection, then attempt a visual claim from it.
cases.expected_outcome: The claim is refused: an appearance claim needs visual inspection evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the content inspection, attempt the appearance claim, read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the recorded claim kinds.

cases.title: A visual inspection cannot support an interaction claim
cases.task: Record a visual inspection of a screenshot, then claim observed behaviour.
cases.expected_outcome: The behaviour claim is refused, and a later interaction inspection can support it.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the behaviour claim from the screenshot, then from an interaction transcript.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both refusals/acceptances and the recorded claim kinds.

cases.title: The local reference adapter discovers and hashes project material
cases.task: Discover local reference files and retrieve their metadata through the adapter.
cases.expected_outcome: Discovery finds the file, metadata carries a real content digest, and visual inspection is supported.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the adapter's declared capabilities and compare with the file on disk.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The adapter capability record, candidates and retrieved digest.

cases.title: An unconfigured adapter reports its own unavailability
cases.task: Ask the approved-URL and paid-provider adapters what they can do and attempt retrieval.
cases.expected_outcome: Both report themselves disabled with a reason and return an inaccessible result, never a fabricated one.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the capability records and the retrieval results; assert no network capability is claimed.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The capability records and the inaccessible results with their blockers.

cases.title: An adapter never supplies evidence it did not declare
cases.task: Ask the local reference adapter for interaction inspection.
cases.expected_outcome: The call is refused: a file cannot show interaction, and the adapter never declared it.
cases.evaluation_method: Call inspect_interaction on the local adapter and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the declared capability list.

cases.title: A gated source is not bypassed and a claim in a title is not provenance
cases.task: Attempt a paid-provider reference and register a title that asserts a claim.
cases.expected_outcome: The provider stays unavailable; a title asserting a best practice is refused at registration.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the gated retrieval and register the assertive title; read both refusals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both refusals and the adapter's declared capabilities.

cases.title: An existing project component is preferred over a new dependency
cases.task: Evaluate a need that an existing project component already solves.
cases.expected_outcome: The candidate selects the first rung, requires no approval, and installs nothing.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the candidate and read the recorded rung, decision and install authority.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The evaluation record with its rung, decision and existing-equivalent check.

cases.title: A native platform capability is preferred over a dependency
cases.task: Evaluate a native solution for the need against an external package.
cases.expected_outcome: The native rung selects without an approval and no dependency is proposed.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the native candidate and read the decision and registry record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The evaluation record.

cases.title: A component whose compatibility or licence is unknown is blocked
cases.task: Evaluate an external dependency whose licence nobody established.
cases.expected_outcome: The candidate is blocked, never selected, and the unknown findings are named.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the candidate with unknown licence and compatibility and read the decision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The evaluation record with its blocking findings.

cases.title: A dependency recommendation is not installation authority
cases.task: Evaluate a fully-known external dependency with no approval, with a fabricated approval id, and with a recorded one.
cases.expected_outcome: No approval and a fabricated id both leave it blocked; only an approval the engine actually recorded selects it, and even then the install authority is human-only.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate three times and compare the decisions, approval sources and install authority strings.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three evaluation records and their approval sources.

cases.title: Registry metadata is retained with its provenance and freshness
cases.task: Evaluate a registry candidate and inspect the recorded registry record.
cases.expected_outcome: The registry id, the queried entry, its checked_on date and freshness window are recorded.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate against the repository registry and read the registry block.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The registry block of the evaluation record.

cases.title: An actionable direction record is accepted and constrains implementation
cases.task: Record a direction with concrete hierarchy, interaction and responsive rules.
cases.expected_outcome: The record is accepted, unapproved, and every constraining section is present.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the direction and read the record and its status.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The direction record with its sections and status.

cases.title: A vague direction is refused as unactionable
cases.task: Record a direction whose only visual principle is 'modern, sleek and intuitive'.
cases.expected_outcome: The record is refused with a message naming the generic language.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the vague direction and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the absence of a record.

cases.title: An implementer cannot approve its own design direction
cases.task: Record the handoff worker identity, then attempt to approve the direction as that worker.
cases.expected_outcome: The approval is refused and no G1D approval is recorded.
cases.evaluation_method: Set the worker identity in the state, attempt approval, read the refusal and the approvals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the empty approval list.

cases.title: A material direction edit invalidates its approval
cases.task: Approve a direction, then change an interaction principle and re-check.
cases.expected_outcome: The approval is valid before the edit and stale after it; a cosmetic edit does not invalidate it.
cases.evaluation_method: Approve, mutate the record, and read the gate result each time.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three gate results and the two revision fingerprints.

cases.title: A trivial task is not forced through the direction workflow
cases.task: Characterise a one-file spacing fix and check the direction requirement it produces.
cases.expected_outcome: DIRECT is not REQUIRED and the boundary declares no direction approval requirement.
cases.evaluation_method: Characterise, select the pipeline, then evaluate the S4B requirement record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The selected DIRECT stage and the requirement record.

cases.title: A source-level requirement closes from source evidence
cases.task: Close a source-level requirement with a source suggestion at its real anchor.
cases.expected_outcome: The requirement reaches observed from source evidence; a rendered requirement could not.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the requirement and read its state, then attempt the same evidence for a rendered claim.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The closure records and the refusal for the rendered claim.

cases.title: A rendered requirement cannot be verified from source inspection alone
cases.task: Attempt to verify a rendered requirement using only a source suggestion.
cases.expected_outcome: The closure is refused: a source suggestion is not a rendered observation.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the closure and read the refusal naming the evidence weakness.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the unchanged requirement list.

cases.title: A requirement with no evidence stays unobserved, and an unverified capture is honest
cases.task: Record a rendered requirement with no evidence, and one explicitly unverified with a blocker.
cases.expected_outcome: No state above implemented is recorded without evidence; the blocker is preserved.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the closure, then record the unverified capture and read the requirement problems.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the unverified record with its blocker.

cases.title: A stale rendered artifact invalidates the verification that used it
cases.task: Verify a requirement from a capture, then change the captured artifact and re-check.
cases.expected_outcome: The requirement is verified while current and stale as soon as the artifact changes.
cases.evaluation_method: Verify, modify the artifact, and compare stale_requirements before and after.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The stale report before and after the edit.

cases.title: A screenshot file without capture provenance is not trusted
cases.task: Attempt to record an arbitrary screenshot file as rendered evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: The record is refused: evidence must arrive through a capture adapter with a verified digest.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt to record the bare file and read the refusal; the file is never accepted.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the absent evidence record.

cases.title: Evidence captured for another revision is stale
cases.task: Capture at one revision and query staleness at another.
cases.expected_outcome: The capture is current for its own revision and stale for a different one.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare stale_records at the capturing revision and at a new revision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both stale reports and the captured revision.

cases.title: Evidence for one viewport does not satisfy another
cases.task: Capture at 375px and ask for the strongest evidence at 1280px.
cases.expected_outcome: The 375px capture is found for 375 and not returned for 1280.
cases.evaluation_method: Query the strongest evidence per viewport and compare.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The per-viewport results.

cases.title: The offline fixture adapter records hashed evidence for the workflow
cases.task: Capture a screenshot, DOM and accessibility result from the offline fixture.
cases.expected_outcome: Each artifact exists, hashes match, the record names its method and environment, and no browser is claimed.
cases.evaluation_method: Capture three kinds, re-hash the files, and read the recorded provenance.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The capture records, their hashes and their declared method.

cases.title: Externally declared evidence cannot be promoted to observed
cases.task: Record a declared-observer artifact, then attempt to promote it to observed.
cases.expected_outcome: The artifact records as RENDERED and the promotion is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the declared artifact and attempt the observation.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The record's state and the refusal.

cases.title: Externally declared evidence cannot be promoted to verified
cases.task: Record a declared-observer artifact and attempt to verify it by re-production.
cases.expected_outcome: The verification is refused: re-hashing the same external file under a second execution is not independent re-production.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the declared artifact, attempt verify, and read the refusal and the unchanged state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the record state and the verification execution used.

cases.title: An unconfigured browser capability is reported, never faked
cases.task: Ask the capture adapters what they can do and attempt a browser capture.
cases.expected_outcome: The browser adapter reports unavailable with a reason and capture is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the capability matrix and attempt the capture.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The capability matrix, the refusal and the route decision status.

cases.title: An implementer cannot certify its own visual quality
cases.task: Attempt a critique whose reviewer identity and execution are the implementer's.
cases.expected_outcome: The critique is refused on both the identity and the execution check.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the self-review and read the refusal; assert no review record exists.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the unchanged review list.

cases.title: A critique of rendered work without rendered evidence is refused
cases.task: Prepare a critique for a task whose rendered QA is REQUIRED, with no evidence ids.
cases.expected_outcome: Preparation is refused and names the missing rendered evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Call prepare_review with no evidence and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the characterisation that required rendering.

cases.title: A critique against a changed direction is refused
cases.task: Approve a direction, change a constraining rule, then attempt the critique.
cases.expected_outcome: The critique is refused because it would judge against a revision nobody approved.
cases.evaluation_method: Mutate the direction and attempt the review; read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the earlier approval revision.

cases.title: A valid independent critique records structured findings
cases.task: Run a critique from a distinct reviewer execution against observed evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: The record binds two executions, the direction revision and structured findings that cite evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Build the review and read the record's bindings and findings.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The review record with its execution binding, direction revision and findings.

cases.title: A finding must cite evidence and name a repair scope
cases.task: Submit a critique whose finding cites no evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: The critique is refused and no review record is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the review and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the unchanged review list.

cases.title: A finding produces a scoped repair, not a redesign
cases.task: Propose a refinement for a contrast finding and inspect its scope.
cases.expected_outcome: The plan names the finding, the scope, the expected evidence and the regression checks.
cases.evaluation_method: Propose the refinement and read the record; the finding state only changes after the result.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refinement record and the still-open finding.

cases.title: A repair re-captures the affected evidence and resolves its finding
cases.task: Apply the refinement, re-capturing the evidence it declared.
cases.expected_outcome: The cycle verifies, the finding becomes repaired, and no regression is reported.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the refinement result with the declared evidence and read the outcome.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refinement result, the resolved finding and the summary.

cases.title: A repair that touches artifacts outside its scope is refused
cases.task: Record a refinement result that changed a file outside the permitted scope.
cases.expected_outcome: The result is refused and the refinement stays proposed.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the out-of-scope result and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the unchanged refinement state.

cases.title: Design refinement stops at the bounded budget
cases.task: Propose and apply refinements until the budget is exhausted, then attempt one more.
cases.expected_outcome: The budget reports the limit, the extra proposal is refused, and the reason is named.
cases.evaluation_method: Loop proposals, read the budget and the final refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The budget records and the refusal.

cases.title: A repair that breaks a passing check is a regression, not a fix
cases.task: Record a refinement result that reports a regression.
cases.expected_outcome: The cycle fails, the finding stays unresolved, and both remain visible in the summary.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the regressing result and read the refinement, the finding and the summary.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The failed refinement, the unresolved finding and the summary.

cases.title: A non-blocking finding cannot authorize a broad redesign
cases.task: Propose a refinement for a minor finding whose scope is the whole interface.
cases.expected_outcome: The proposal is refused: the repair must name the smallest affected artifacts.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the broad proposal and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the absence of a refinement record.

cases.title: The direction-record gate never substitutes for the DESIGN.md gate
cases.task: Approve a design direction (G1D) and check the G1 gate and the reverse.
cases.expected_outcome: G1D satisfies only G1D; G1 still reports no approval and DESIGN.md staleness still applies.
cases.evaluation_method: Approve G1D, then evaluate both gates and try to satisfy G1D with a G1 approval.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both gate results and the recorded approvals.

cases.title: A non-human channel cannot approve a design direction
cases.task: Attempt a direction approval on the worker channel.
cases.expected_outcome: The approval is refused and nothing is recorded.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the approval with channel=worker-cli and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the empty approval list.

cases.title: Component research cannot install or change the project
cases.task: Evaluate a new dependency and inspect the module for any installation path.
cases.expected_outcome: No dependency is installed, no project file changes, and the module imports no process launcher.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the evaluation, compare the project before and after, and inspect the module source.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The before/after file set, the install authority string and the module imports.

cases.title: Source inspection can never prove rendered quality
cases.task: Record a source suggestion and compare its strength with rendered and observed evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: A source suggestion is the weakest state and cannot satisfy a rendered threshold.
cases.evaluation_method: Record a source suggestion and compare ordinal strengths.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The recorded state and the strengths.

cases.title: Design events join the canonical chain and never weaken it
cases.task: Run design-plan and record one reference, then verify the engine event log.
cases.expected_outcome: Design events are present, the digest chain verifies, and the new types are declared.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the event log, its integrity check and the declared vocabulary.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The event type counts, the integrity report and the log path.

cases.title: Design context stays role- and task-specific
cases.task: Decide context for a design source with and without a design requirement, and for a forbidden source.
cases.expected_outcome: A design source is omitted when the task needs no design work, never resurrected when forbidden, and included when required.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare three context decisions: irrelevant, forbidden, required.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three decision records with their reasons.

cases.title: A design evidence need with no declared adapter blocks the route
cases.task: Route a task that requires rendered observation with no capture adapter configured.
cases.expected_outcome: The route is blocked by the design-evidence rule, and a configured adapter satisfies it.
cases.evaluation_method: Route once with no adapters and once with the offline fixture; compare.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both routing decisions and their rules.

cases.title: Design measurements are deterministic and match the records
cases.task: Run a small design workflow and compare the counters with the recorded collections.
cases.expected_outcome: Counters equal the records; no design quality score is reported.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the engine workflow and compare measure() with the state collections.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The measurement record and the state collection sizes.

cases.title: Traversal, absolute and prefix-collision paths cannot become provenance
cases.task: Cite usage artifacts outside the project: a sibling file, a .. traversal to it, and a sibling directory that shares the project's name prefix.
cases.expected_outcome: Every attempt is refused before anything is stored, and the reference stays ANALYSED.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt each citation and read the refusals and the unchanged record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal texts, the record state and the absent usage record.

cases.title: The CLI ingest path refuses an out-of-project usage artifact too
cases.task: Drive the full reference lifecycle through record-design, then cite a usage artifact outside the project.
cases.expected_outcome: The CLI event is refused, the reference stays ANALYSED and no usage record is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Submit the events through the CLI and read the refusal and the persisted state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the exit code and the reference record.

cases.title: A refused operation leaves the reference byte-identical
cases.task: Attempt an illegal lifecycle move, a re-retrieval, a late inaccessible move, an analysis citing a missing inspection, and an unanchored usage.
cases.expected_outcome: Each refusal leaves the record exactly as it was; nothing partial is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Snapshot the record, attempt each refusal, and compare the snapshot.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The snapshots and the refusals.

cases.title: A direction missing a required section is refused
cases.task: Record a direction event that omits findings_rejected entirely.
cases.expected_outcome: The event is refused and no direction record is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Submit the event through the CLI and read the refusal and the empty collection.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the absent record.

cases.title: A direction with an empty required section is refused
cases.task: Record a direction whose approved_deviations and reference_findings_adopted sections are present but empty.
cases.expected_outcome: Both variants are refused and no direction record is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Submit each event through the CLI and read the refusals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal texts and the empty collection.

cases.title: A near-match artifact cannot inherit a refinement's scope
cases.task: Propose a refinement scoped to the substring 'styles', then report a change to srcx/styles/landing.css.
cases.expected_outcome: The near-match is refused as out of scope and the refinement stays proposed; the old substring rule accepted this pair.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the out-of-scope close and read the refusal and the unchanged record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the state and the scope comparison.

cases.title: An in-scope artifact still closes a refinement
cases.task: Close the same refinement with the src/styles/** vocabulary and its re-taken evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: The glob-scoped artifact is accepted and the refinement closes as verified.
cases.evaluation_method: Close the refinement and read the state and the recorded change.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refinement record and its state.

cases.title: Dependency, build and VCS trees are never scanned
cases.task: Give a project a design token in src and a large fake design system under node_modules and .git.
cases.expected_outcome: Only the project's own stylesheet contributes design-system evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Characterise the project and read the maturity evidence.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The maturity evidence text and the scan bound note.

cases.title: An oversized authoritative collection is refused, never truncated
cases.task: Pre-fill the reference collection to its safety bound and register one more reference.
cases.expected_outcome: The registration is refused with an explicit bound error and nothing is truncated.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the registration and compare the collection length.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text and the unchanged length.

cases.title: A normal collection is unaffected by the bound
cases.task: Register and inspect one reference in an ordinary run.
cases.expected_outcome: The record is accepted and the bound is not reached.
cases.evaluation_method: Register the reference and read its state and the collection length.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The reference record and the collection size.

cases.title: The capability vocabulary is consulted, not decorative
cases.task: Check the vocabulary is consistent, then route with a table entry that names an undeclared capability.
cases.expected_outcome: The consistent vocabulary routes; the inconsistent one is refused before a decision is made.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the vocabulary check, then inject an undeclared capability and route.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The vocabulary problems and the routing refusal.

cases.title: The seven previously fixed review issues remain fixed
cases.task: Re-attempt: declared-observer verification, a fabricated component approval, an empty usage anchor, and an empty expected-evidence list.
cases.expected_outcome: All four are refused: none can be elevated by assertion.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt each bypass and read the refusals and the unchanged records.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The four refusals and the unchanged evidence state.

cases.title: A requested model identity never becomes an observed one
cases.task: Create an execution that requests a model and observe what identity the engine will report.
cases.expected_outcome: Requested identity is recorded at REQUESTED; observed identity stays UNKNOWN.
cases.evaluation_method: Create the execution and read the per-field claim levels.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The claim map and the raw observed fields.

cases.title: A worker's runtime claim never overwrites engine observation
cases.task: Have the worker report a different model and attempt to write a provider observation.
cases.expected_outcome: The worker claim stays declared/reported, the observed channel stays UNKNOWN and the provider channel refuses worker sources.
cases.evaluation_method: Report the claim, attempt the provider observation and read both refusals and the claim map.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the claim map and the observed fields.

cases.title: A well-formed but engine-unknown execution id is not an execution
cases.task: Attempt a rendered-evidence verification and a review binding with an invented exe id.
cases.expected_outcome: Both are refused because the engine did not create that execution for this run.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt both operations and read the refusals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two refusals and the unchanged evidence state.

cases.title: A result cannot be attached to the wrong revision, role or task
cases.task: Attempt to verify one execution's result against a changed revision, another role and another task.
cases.expected_outcome: All three attempts are refused and the execution stays open.
cases.evaluation_method: Call verify_result three ways and read the problems.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three problem lists and the execution state.

cases.title: A replayed result and a duplicate provider request id are refused
cases.task: Complete one execution twice and have two executions claim one provider request id.
cases.expected_outcome: The replay is refused; the duplicate request id is reported as a provenance conflict.
cases.evaluation_method: Complete twice, record two provider observations with one request id and read the conflict.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The replay refusal and the conflict list.

cases.title: A declared capability is never reported as verified
cases.task: Declare a capability and attempt to observe it as VERIFIED without a verification record.
cases.expected_outcome: The declaration is DECLARED; the VERIFIED observation is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Declare, resolve the status, attempt the verification and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The resolved status, the refusal and the registry counters.

cases.title: An exercised capability needs the execution that exercised it
cases.task: Attempt to record EXERCISED from a claim and then from a real engine execution.
cases.expected_outcome: The claim is refused; the engine execution establishes EXERCISED with evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt both observations and read the refusal and the accepted record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the exercised record.

cases.title: An observed-unavailable capability is excluded from routing
cases.task: Route design evidence through an adapter whose capability was observed unavailable.
cases.expected_outcome: The route is blocked with design-evidence-unavailable and the exclusion names the observation.
cases.evaluation_method: Observe UNAVAILABLE, route the evidence need and read the decision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The route decision, its candidates and the exclusion reason.

cases.title: Strict routing does not accept a declaration, and the policy is recorded
cases.task: Route the same evidence need under the declared and strict policies with no registry evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: Declared selects; strict blocks and records the policy it applied.
cases.evaluation_method: Route twice and read the policy and the exclusion.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both route decisions and the recorded policy.

cases.title: Deterministic probes report availability and unavailability honestly
cases.task: Probe a present executable, a missing executable and a fixture command.
cases.expected_outcome: Present reports AVAILABLE, missing reports UNAVAILABLE with a reason, the fixture command EXERCISES.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the three probes and read their statuses and evidence.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three probe records.

cases.title: Independence is bound to executions, not to labels
cases.task: Compare a relabelled self-review, a fabricated pair and two engine-created executions.
cases.expected_outcome: The same execution is NONE, the fabricated pair is only DECLARED_DISTINCT and the engine pair is ENGINE_DISTINCT_EXECUTION.
cases.evaluation_method: Compute the independence level for all three pairs.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three levels and the refusal for the self-review.

cases.title: Observed runtime and provider differences raise the independence level
cases.task: Compare two executions with one runtime, then with different runtimes, then with different observed providers.
cases.expected_outcome: The level rises from ENGINE_DISTINCT_EXECUTION to DISTINCT_RUNTIME to DISTINCT_PROVIDER.
cases.evaluation_method: Compute the level as each observed fact changes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three levels and the observed facts behind them.

cases.title: A review cannot bind a revision the evidence no longer matches
cases.task: Prepare a design critique whose rendered evidence belongs to a different revision.
cases.expected_outcome: The critique is refused because the evidence is stale for the reviewed revision.
cases.evaluation_method: Record evidence for one revision, prepare the critique for another and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the unchanged review list.

cases.title: Re-hashing the captured artifact is not independent re-production
cases.task: Attempt to verify a capture by re-opening the same file, then by re-producing a new one.
cases.expected_outcome: The re-open is refused; the new artifact verifies and records a verification record.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt both verifications and read the refusal and the verification record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the verification record and the dependency fingerprints.

cases.title: A changed capture parameter makes the rendered verification stale
cases.task: Verify a capture and re-evaluate its currentness against changed capture parameters.
cases.expected_outcome: The verification is CURRENT for its parameters and STALE for the changed ones.
cases.evaluation_method: Verify, evaluate currentness twice and read both verdicts.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two currentness verdicts and the dependency fingerprints.

cases.title: Declared evidence cannot be verified by re-production
cases.task: Record a declared-observer artifact and attempt an independent verification of it.
cases.expected_outcome: The verification is refused, no verification record is written and the state stays RENDERED.
cases.evaluation_method: Record, attempt the verification and read the refusal and the state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the record state and the verification list.

cases.title: A locator string is not retrieval and an asserted digest is refused
cases.task: Register a local reference, attempt to assert its digest and then retrieve it honestly.
cases.expected_outcome: The asserted digest is refused; the honest retrieval records local-read with remote origin unproven.
cases.evaluation_method: Register, attempt the assertion, retrieve and read the mode and origin.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the retrieval mode and the origin record.

cases.title: Remote origin is proven only by an independent retrieval verification
cases.task: Retrieve a local reference, verify the retrieval with an engine execution and check the origin and currentness.
cases.expected_outcome: Before verification the origin is unproven; after it a verification record exists; changed content makes it stale.
cases.evaluation_method: Retrieve, verify, read the origin and re-evaluate currentness against changed content.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The origin record, the verification record and the staleness verdict.

cases.title: A claimed remote origin without a verification is a provenance problem
cases.task: Present a reference record that claims a proven remote origin with no retrieval verification.
cases.expected_outcome: The provenance check reports it and the reference cannot be treated as verified.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the cross-record provenance check and read the problem.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The provenance problems.

cases.title: A valid bounded decision records its answer, provenance and policy version
cases.task: Ask one choice question with a deterministic provider and read the decision record.
cases.expected_outcome: The batch and the decision record carry the provider, model version, contract and policy versions, and no authorization effect.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the batch and inspect the decision record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The batch record and the decision record.

cases.title: An answer outside the declared space is refused, never coerced
cases.task: Have the provider answer with a value outside the closed option set.
cases.expected_outcome: The decision is recorded invalid with the raw answer preserved and no acceptance.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the batch and read the decision status and problems.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The invalid decision record and the policy verdict absence.

cases.title: Self-reported confidence is preserved and never promoted
cases.task: Ask a low-consequence and a medium-consequence question with self-reported confidence.
cases.expected_outcome: Low is accepted as decision evidence, medium is refused with a fallback, and the kind stays self-reported.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate both and read the policy verdicts.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two decision records and their verdicts.

cases.title: A missing confidence is recorded as NONE, never guessed
cases.task: Answer a low-consequence question with no confidence at all.
cases.expected_outcome: The confidence stays null with kind NONE, the verdict is accepted and marked low-confidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the batch and read the record and verdict.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The decision record with its null confidence.

cases.title: A decision can never authorize a protected action
cases.task: Ask a protected-consequence question with the strongest confidence and attempt to act on a refusal.
cases.expected_outcome: The protected question is refused regardless of confidence, and acting on a refused decision is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the protected question and attempt to mark a refused decision as acted on.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal, the verdict and the unchanged decision record.

cases.title: Independent questions are answered in one provider call and never chained
cases.task: Ask two independent questions in one batch and verify the call count and per-question records.
cases.expected_outcome: One provider call answers both; each decision carries its own question id and the shared state digest.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the batch, count the provider calls and read both records.
