cases.evidence_required_for_success: The batch record, the two decision records and the provider call log.

cases.title: A provider failure is recorded as a failure and falls back deterministically
cases.task: Have the provider fail and then classify an unmapped failure source with it.
cases.expected_outcome: The batch is failed with the reason, and classification falls back to UNKNOWN with escalation.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the batch, classify with the failing provider and read both outcomes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The failed batch and the fallback classification.

cases.title: Failure classification uses code first and bounded judgement only when needed
cases.task: Classify a mapped source, then an unmapped one, with and without an available provider.
cases.expected_outcome: Mapped sources never consult a provider; unmapped sources use the bounded decision; unavailable providers fall back to UNKNOWN.
cases.evaluation_method: Classify four ways and count provider calls.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The four classifications and the call log.

cases.title: A verification claiming evidence that does not exist is refused
cases.task: Attempt to record an observation whose evidence artifact is a fabricated path.
cases.expected_outcome: The record is refused and no verification exists.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the record and read the refusal and the verification list.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the empty verification list.

cases.title: A verification with no execution and no evidence is refused
cases.task: Attempt to record an OBSERVED verification from prose alone.
cases.expected_outcome: The refusal names the missing execution or anchor and the missing evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the record and read the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the empty verification list.

cases.title: A passing verification from a changed revision does not answer as current
cases.task: Record a verified claim, change its dependency and re-read the status.
cases.expected_outcome: The record answers as STALE and its established level is preserved as history.
cases.evaluation_method: Verify, refresh against a changed dependency and read the effective level.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refreshed record and the effective level.

cases.title: An orphan result cannot be attached to a new execution
cases.task: Attempt to verify a result against another execution, task and revision.
cases.expected_outcome: Every mismatch is refused and the target execution is untouched.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt three attachments and read the problems.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three problem lists.

cases.title: Recovery refuses to convert an ambiguous state into success
cases.task: Ask recovery for proposals on a duplicate-result and an interrupted execution.
cases.expected_outcome: The ambiguous state is refused; the interrupted execution is abandoned as INTERRUPTED with no result claimed.
cases.evaluation_method: Build the findings and read both proposals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two proposals and their reasons.

cases.title: The CLI and the engine refuse the same fabricated claim identically
cases.task: Attempt a fabricated execution provenance through the CLI and through the engine.
cases.expected_outcome: Both refuse with the same engine reason; neither surface accepts what the other refuses.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the CLI command and the engine call and compare the refusals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both refusal strings.

cases.title: A task tree totals every node that spent something
cases.task: Create a worker, a repair, a validation and a decision batch on one task and read the task cost.
cases.expected_outcome: Every node appears in the tree and the totals are the exact sum of the measured fields.
cases.evaluation_method: Create the executions, record usage, build the tree and compare the totals with the inputs.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The tree, the cost totals and the per-node usage.

cases.title: Cached and uncached input tokens stay separate
cases.task: Record cached and uncached input tokens and read the task totals.
cases.expected_outcome: Both fields survive into the task totals and neither is collapsed into the other.
cases.evaluation_method: Record the usage and read the totals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The recorded usage values and the task totals.

cases.title: An unmeasured task reports unknown rather than zero
cases.task: Create a task with no measured usage and read its cost.
cases.expected_outcome: The monetary figure is UNKNOWN, usage_complete is false and no token total is invented.
cases.evaluation_method: Create the execution without usage and read the cost view.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The cost view and the list of executions without usage.

cases.title: A failed attempt is part of what the task cost
cases.task: Fail an execution with measured usage, repair it and compare the cost with and without the failure.
cases.expected_outcome: The failed attempt's usage is included in the task total.
cases.evaluation_method: Record usage on a failed execution and read the task totals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The failure record, the usage and the totals.

cases.title: Review and validation spend count toward the verified completion cost
cases.task: Build a verified completion with an observer, a verifier and a reviewer and read the metric.
cases.expected_outcome: The metric is labelled verified_completion_cost and includes every measured execution's usage.
cases.evaluation_method: Create the chain, record usage on each node and read the verified completion cost.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The verification record, the tree and the metric.

cases.title: The same stable prefix renders byte-identical twice
cases.task: Render identical requests twice and compare the stable prefix bytes.
cases.expected_outcome: The stable prefix digest and bytes are identical; a changed stable segment changes them.
cases.evaluation_method: Render twice, compare, change a stable segment and compare again.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both prefix digests and the byte counts.

cases.title: Volatile task data does not move the stable prefix
cases.task: Render two requests that differ only in the volatile task id and compare the stable prefixes.
cases.expected_outcome: The stable prefix is unchanged while the packet id the volatile segment carries differs.
cases.evaluation_method: Render with two different volatile segments and compare.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both prefix digests and the volatile sections.

cases.title: Source buckets are attributable and sum to the measured size
cases.task: Render a packet with policy, project and task sources and read the bucket accounting.
cases.expected_outcome: Each source lands in its own bucket and the byte totals equal the measured sizes.
cases.evaluation_method: Render the packet and compare the bucket byte totals with the section sizes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The harness map rows and the bucket totals.

cases.title: A rendered request never carries a detected secret
cases.task: Render a packet that contains a provider key and read the render.
cases.expected_outcome: The key is replaced by a stable marker, the count is reported and the marker is not the secret.
cases.evaluation_method: Render, search for the secret and compare two renders of the same secret.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The render text, the redaction count and the marker.

cases.title: The compact prompt profile touches only the transport scaffolding
cases.task: Apply the compact_v2 profile to a packet and compare the source sections with the legacy render.
cases.expected_outcome: Scaffolding bytes are removed, the prompt block and every source are byte-identical.
cases.evaluation_method: Render both profiles, compare the section digests and diff the scaffolding.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both renders and the removed byte count.

cases.title: Core capabilities are always selected and their declaration size is measured
cases.task: Select packs for a backend stage and read the core declaration.
cases.expected_outcome: The core pack is selected with its measured size and the five first-turn capabilities.
cases.evaluation_method: Select packs, read the core members and compare the size with the files on disk.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The selection, the core members and the measured size.

cases.title: An unused capability pack is omitted with a recorded reason
cases.task: Select packs for a backend repair task and read the deferred packs.
cases.expected_outcome: Design, research, verification and writing are deferred; the deferrable byte total is measured.
cases.evaluation_method: Select packs and compare the deferred list with the pack registry.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The selection and the deferred byte total.

cases.title: A pack a task requires is selected with its reason
cases.task: Select packs for a design task that selected the reference-analysis skill.
cases.expected_outcome: Design, research and their reasons are recorded; the required capability is provided.
cases.evaluation_method: Select packs with a stage, skills and required capabilities and read the reasons.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The selection reasons and the loaded member list.

cases.title: A required capability that is not loaded refuses rather than continuing
cases.task: Ask for a pack list that omits a required capability and read the guard.
cases.expected_outcome: The guard reports the missing capability and does not silently proceed.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the guard with a capability the selection does not provide.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The guard's problems and the selection it was checked against.

cases.title: A large output is stored completely, not truncated
cases.task: Externalize a 78 KB output and read the artifact from disk.
cases.expected_outcome: The artifact contains every byte and the status is excerpt plus artifact.
cases.evaluation_method: Externalize, read the file and compare its length with the input.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The artifact record, the stored file and its size.

cases.title: The recorded digest is the digest of the stored bytes
cases.task: Externalize an output, re-hash the artifact and compare with the record.
cases.expected_outcome: The digests match and a tampered artifact is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Verify the artifact, then tamper with it and verify again.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both digest verdicts.

cases.title: The excerpt is a head and tail of the real output
cases.task: Externalize a numbered output and check the excerpt against the original.
cases.expected_outcome: The head starts the output, the tail ends it and the omitted byte count is exact.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the excerpt strings with the original and compute the omitted bytes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The excerpt, the tail and the omitted byte count.

cases.title: The complete artifact is retrievable and digest-checked
cases.task: Retrieve the full artifact through the engine and through a broken reference.
cases.expected_outcome: The full text comes back for a good record and a missing artifact is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Retrieve the record, then retrieve a record pointing at a missing file.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The retrieved length and the refusal.

cases.title: A verification can read the original full artifact
cases.task: Externalize an output, record a verification against the artifact and re-hash it.
cases.expected_outcome: The verification is created at OBSERVED against the stored artifact and stays current.
cases.evaluation_method: Externalize, verify the claim through the engine and refresh the freshness.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The verification record and the artifact verdict.

cases.title: The runtime preserves a large validation output instead of keeping only its digest
cases.task: Call the runtime's validation-output seam with a large and a small output and read the results.
cases.expected_outcome: The large output is stored in full with a reference and the small output is untouched.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the runtime seam twice and inspect the artifact, the state collection and the small case.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The artifact, its digest and the returned fields.

cases.title: Repeated identical history content is measured as a duplicate, not re-delivered
cases.task: Build a history with an exact duplicate and measure it, then compact it.
cases.expected_outcome: The duplicate is measured and the compacted active view carries it once.
cases.evaluation_method: Measure the history, compact it and count the duplicate markers.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The economics figures and the compaction result.

cases.title: A forbidden source is never delivered, cached or resurrected
cases.task: Decide context for a forbidden source with a cache entry present and read the plan.
cases.expected_outcome: The source is omitted as FORBIDDEN_FOR_STAGE and the plan cannot add it back.
cases.evaluation_method: Decide, build the plan and read the omission.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The decision rows and the plan.

cases.title: A required source is delivered even when a plan tries to omit it
cases.task: Decide context for a required source and attempt an omission plan.
cases.expected_outcome: The required source is included and the plan carries no omission for it.
cases.evaluation_method: Decide, build the plan and read the decision rows.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The decision row and the plan.

cases.title: A changed source invalidates its cached hash
cases.task: Reuse a cached source, change it and decide again.
cases.expected_outcome: The first decision reuses the cached hash; after the change the hash is re-derived.
cases.evaluation_method: Decide twice with the file changed in between and compare the reasons.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both decisions and the invalidations.

cases.title: Compaction carries the current task state verbatim
cases.task: Compact a history and read the active view for the task state.
cases.expected_outcome: The task-state entry and the revision entry are carried verbatim.
cases.evaluation_method: Compact and compare the protected entries with the originals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The active view and the archive.

cases.title: Compaction cannot drop unresolved work or a protected decision
cases.task: Attempt an unsafe compaction plan and read the refusal.
cases.expected_outcome: A plan that would omit a protected entry is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the guard with a plan that drops the unresolved-work entry.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal and the plan.

cases.title: The complete original history stays retrievable after compaction
cases.task: Compact a history, retrieve the archive and compare it with the originals.
cases.expected_outcome: Every original entry comes back from the archive and a tampered archive is refused.
cases.evaluation_method: Compact, retrieve, compare and tamper.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The retrieved entries and the archive digest.

cases.title: Bulk tool noise is structured out of the active view
cases.task: Compact a history with a large tool output and read the active entry.
cases.expected_outcome: The tool output becomes one structured line with its digest while remaining archived.
cases.evaluation_method: Compact and inspect the tool-output entry.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The active entry, its digest and the archive.

cases.title: Independent questions share one state and one request
cases.task: Evaluate a batch of two independent questions and read the economics view.
cases.expected_outcome: One provider call, two decisions, one shared state digest and no dependency problems.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the batch and read the decision economics.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The batch record and the economics row.

cases.title: A dependent question is refused inside one batch and planned as a second step
cases.task: Declare a dependency between two questions and read the guard and the plan.
cases.expected_outcome: The guard refuses the dependent batch; the planner puts the dependent question in step two.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the dependency guard and the batch planner.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The guard's problems and the planned steps.

cases.title: A batch's usage is attributed to the task and never invented
cases.task: Evaluate a batch with no measured usage and read the attribution.
cases.expected_outcome: The batch is attributed to the task, its usage is unmeasured and no cost is invented.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate, read the economics rows and compare with the recorded usage.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The batch row, the attribution and the measured flag.

cases.title: A simple low-stakes task keeps the short path with validation
cases.task: Derive the path for a low-stakes mechanical task and read the retained steps.
cases.expected_outcome: The simple path is chosen, decision and review are skipped and validation is retained.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the planner and read the retained and skipped steps.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan and the verification guard.

cases.title: A high-stakes design task keeps review, validation and acceptance
cases.task: Derive the path for a high-stakes design task and read the retained steps.
cases.expected_outcome: The complex path retains decision, routing, review, validation and human acceptance.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the planner and compare the retained steps with the obligations.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan and its reasons.

cases.title: A cheaper path cannot drop a required capability or a required review
cases.task: Ask for a fast path with a required capability and with review required, then read the refusals.
cases.expected_outcome: Neither request yields the simple path and the verification guard refuses a crafted plan.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the planner with each obstacle and check the guard on a hand-built plan.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both plans and the guard problems.

cases.title: Rendered packet economics for every prepared stage
cases.task: Assemble real S1, S3, S4A and S4B packets and measure their rendered structure.
cases.expected_outcome: Measurement-only: bytes, buckets, stable/volatile split and the compact-profile delta.
cases.evaluation_method: Render each packet with the harness and the prompt profiles and record the figures.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Per-stage measurements plus the tool-schema and prompt-audit totals.

cases.title: Local performance of the AR-204 operations
cases.task: Time the new engine operations with warm-up and repeats on a real packet and a real history.
cases.expected_outcome: Measurement-only: median and p90 for rendering, serialization, compaction and accounting.
cases.evaluation_method: Warm up, repeat and record the median and p90 wall time per operation.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Per-operation timing statistics and the memo hit rate.

cases.title: Every repository version surface names the same release
cases.task: Check VERSION, pyproject, release notes, install docs and the installation example together.
cases.expected_outcome: The engine's version consistency gate reports no disagreements.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the engine release check against the repository root.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The problem list for each surface.

cases.title: The runtime CLI reports the canonical version
cases.task: Run scripts/ariadne.py --version.
cases.expected_outcome: The first line names the VERSION file value and the engine contract is printed.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the output with VERSION.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit code and both output lines.

cases.title: The release manifest agrees with VERSION and carries the runtime allowlist
cases.task: Build the runtime manifest in memory and compare its version and files with the tree.
cases.expected_outcome: The manifest version is VERSION, the project-state range is present, and no private tree is listed.
cases.evaluation_method: Read build-release.runtime_manifest() and inspect the file names.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Manifest version, project-state range and the private-path check.

cases.title: Release notes and install docs name the release-candidate version
cases.task: Read RELEASE-NOTES.md and the four install documents.
cases.expected_outcome: The notes open with the canonical heading and every install document carries the immutable wheel URL.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the heading and the URL with VERSION.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The heading line and the URL check for each document.

cases.title: The protocol and migration surfaces carry explicit versions
cases.task: Read the engine's integration and migration constants.
cases.expected_outcome: The protocol is inside its supported range, the migration target is the record contract, and the report schema is versioned.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare integration.describe() with contracts.SCHEMA_RECORD and migration.REPORT_SCHEMA.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Protocol description and migration constants.

cases.title: The package-name collision is decided and warned about, not accidental
cases.task: Read pyproject.toml and the README compatibility warning.
cases.expected_outcome: The distribution name is unchanged, the warning about the GraphQL package is present, and no publication metadata implies a PyPI release.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect the two files and the release descriptor's publication state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Name, warning token and publication state.

cases.title: A locally built release directory verifies against its own manifest
cases.task: Build the runtime bundle and launcher wheel into the sandbox and verify every digest.
cases.expected_outcome: The engine's artifact check reports no problems.
cases.evaluation_method: Run release.artifact_problems() over the built directory.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The problem list and the artifact names.

cases.title: A release directory with a stale artifact hash fails verification
cases.task: Build artifacts, corrupt the descriptor digest and verify again.
cases.expected_outcome: The stale digest is reported as a mismatch.
cases.evaluation_method: Mutate the descriptor and read the problem list.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Problem list before and after the mutation.

cases.title: The launcher wheel carries the seed runtime, licence and console entry
cases.task: Build the launcher wheel and inspect its contents.
cases.expected_outcome: The wheel is named for VERSION, carries ariadne/seed-runtime.zip and the Apache licence, and declares the ariadne entry point.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the wheel's name list and metadata.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Wheel name and matching entries.

cases.title: Behavior-sensitive AR-204 optimizations are still off by default
cases.task: Read the efficiency policy defaults and the release gate for them.
cases.expected_outcome: Every behavior-sensitive setting keeps its conservative default, and the gate passes.
cases.evaluation_method: Run experimental_defaults_problems() and read DEFAULT_FLAGS.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Defaults and the problem list.

cases.title: The migration dry run reports without writing
cases.task: Run the plan over a v1-era run and compare the state bytes with the original.
cases.expected_outcome: The plan names the transformations and backup, and no file in the run root changes.
cases.evaluation_method: Snapshot the run root, run the plan, compare digests.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Plan fields and the unchanged digest list.

cases.title: Every persisted object is classified before migration
cases.task: Plan a migration over a fixture with a ledger, a document mirror and a packet manifest.
cases.expected_outcome: The run state is MIGRATE, the ledger and manifest are READ_DIRECTLY, and documents are LEGACY_READ_ONLY.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the object classifications.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The classification rows.

cases.title: Migration preserves authority and invents none
cases.task: Migrate a v1-era run that carries one legacy approval.
cases.expected_outcome: The approval survives unchanged, no new approval or review appears, and the engine marker is recorded.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare the approval list and the migration record before and after.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Approval list, migration record, backup digest.

cases.title: A repeated migration is a no-op
cases.task: Apply the migration twice and compare the state bytes and the evidence records.
cases.expected_outcome: The second apply changes nothing and adds no evidence record.
cases.evaluation_method: Digest the state before and after the second apply.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: State digests and the report record count.

cases.title: An existing backup is preserved rather than replaced
cases.task: Place a sentinel at the backup path, then migrate.
cases.expected_outcome: The sentinel bytes survive the migration untouched.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the backup file after the apply.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Backup bytes.

cases.title: Unreadable or malformed legacy state is refused before any write
cases.task: Point the migration at an unsupported schema and at a structurally invalid state.
cases.expected_outcome: Both refuse and leave the run root untouched.
cases.evaluation_method: Catch the refusals and compare the file list.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal texts and the unchanged files.

cases.title: Rollback restores the original bytes and preserves the migrated state
cases.task: Migrate a v1-era run, then roll back.
cases.expected_outcome: The state returns byte-exact to the original and the migrated state is kept as a distinct file.
cases.evaluation_method: Compare digests before, after migration and after rollback.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Digests and the preserved file.

cases.title: Rollback refuses to discard records created under v2
cases.task: Migrate, record a v2 approval, then attempt a rollback.
cases.expected_outcome: The rollback is refused, the state is unchanged and the pre-migration bytes remain available.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the refusal and compare the state digest.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal text, state digest and backup presence.

cases.title: Apply and rollback each append durable evidence
cases.task: Migrate, roll back and read the migration report.
cases.expected_outcome: The report holds one apply and one rollback record with the expected digests.
cases.evaluation_method: Read migration-report.json.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The evidence records.

cases.title: The migrate command exposes dry run, apply and rollback
cases.task: Read the migrate command help text.
cases.expected_outcome: All three actions are listed and the dry run is described as the default.
cases.evaluation_method: Run --help for the migrate command.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The help text.

cases.title: Protocol negotiation accepts, refuses and reports unknown fields
cases.task: Replay the contract fixtures for a happy path, a future version and an unknown capability.
cases.expected_outcome: The happy path accepts, the other two refuse with explicit reasons and unknown fields are only reported.
cases.evaluation_method: Call integration.negotiate() for each fixture.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The description and problem lists.

cases.title: The contract description states where authority lives
cases.task: Read integration.describe().
cases.expected_outcome: Operations, capabilities, versions and the engine-authority statement are all present.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect the description.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The description.

cases.title: Adapter operations return versioned envelopes owned by the engine
cases.task: Start a sandbox run and inspect it through the consumer adapter.
cases.expected_outcome: The envelope carries the envelope schema, the engine authority marker and the parsed state.
cases.evaluation_method: Call inspect_task through the adapter and read the envelope.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The envelope.

cases.title: An unsupported operation is refused explicitly
cases.task: Ask the adapter for an operation it does not implement.
cases.expected_outcome: An IntegrationError names the supported operations; no state is touched.
cases.evaluation_method: Catch the refusal.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal text.

cases.title: Extra payload fields never become authority
cases.task: Request an approval with no gate but an approving extra field.
cases.expected_outcome: The approval is refused and no approval record is written.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the envelope status and the run state.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Envelope status and the approval list.

cases.title: The contract offers no way to record verification directly
cases.task: Read the operation list and attempt validation without worker evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: No verification operation exists and validation refuses without evidence.
cases.evaluation_method: Inspect OPERATIONS and call validate.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The operation list and the refusal status.

cases.title: A consumer can see the migration boundary through the contract
cases.task: Point the adapter at a v1-era run and inspect its migration view.
cases.expected_outcome: The envelope reports the run as pre-migration without applying anything.
cases.evaluation_method: Call inspect_migration and compare the state bytes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The envelope and the unchanged digest.

cases.title: Workflow A: task, execution, independent validation
cases.task: Run the full deterministic S1-to-validated-S4B path for a mechanical task.
cases.expected_outcome: The worker result is validated independently with executed commands and an in-contract scope.
cases.evaluation_method: Drive the fixture path and read validation.json.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Validation status, independence and command records.

cases.title: Workflow B: protected task through review and human acceptance
cases.task: Validate a build, ingest an independent review, record the human gate and accept once.
cases.expected_outcome: Acceptance is refused before the gate, succeeds after it, and the approval cannot be replayed.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the exit codes, lifecycle and consumed approval.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, lifecycle state and the consumed approval id.

cases.title: Workflow C: a refused delivery is repaired and then validated
cases.task: Deliver a blocked return, let the boundary stop, repair with an escalated worker and validate.
cases.expected_outcome: The first delivery is refused without advancing; the escalated repair validates on the second attempt.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the refusal, the packet count and the final validation.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Refusal exit code, packet count and validation status.

cases.title: Workflow D: design direction, evidence, critique and bounded refinement
cases.task: Walk the design chain from an approved direction to a recorded refinement of a critiqued finding.
cases.expected_outcome: The direction is approved, the finding is repaired within its scope and the refinement is verified.
cases.evaluation_method: Build the design chain and read the refinement summary.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Direction state, finding state and refinement state.

cases.title: Workflow E: bounded decision, policy, execution and verification
cases.task: Evaluate one deterministic decision, record its action, then verify the task it informed.
cases.expected_outcome: The decision is bounded, has no authorization effect, the action edge is recorded and verification reaches VERIFIED.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the decision record, the action edge and the verification status.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Decision record, action record and verification record.

cases.title: Workflow F: dry run, migrate, validate and roll back through the CLI
cases.task: Run the migrate command over a v1-era fixture and validate every step.
cases.expected_outcome: Dry run writes nothing, apply preserves the original and rollback restores it, with evidence at every step.
cases.evaluation_method: Drive the CLI and compare digests.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Exit codes, digests and the migration report.

cases.title: A fact code already knows never becomes a model call
cases.task: Compile a plan whose requirement carries a deterministically established value.
cases.expected_outcome: The requirement classifies DETERMINISTIC with reason CODE_KNOWS, no question is created and no provider is consulted.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan with a counting provider and read the classifications and the fact reason.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan record and the empty provider call log.

cases.title: A closed-answer judgement classifies BOUNDED with a projection contract
cases.task: Compile a failure-class requirement.
cases.expected_outcome: It classifies BOUNDED with the failure-classification projection, a consequence and no authorization effect.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan and read the bounded question record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan and its bounded question.

cases.title: Generation is only compiled with a declared reason
cases.task: Compile an implementation requirement that genuinely requires creation.
cases.expected_outcome: It classifies GENERATIVE with CREATION_REQUIRED and is counted as a required generative call.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan and read the generative need and economics.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan and its generative need.

cases.title: A policy-reserved choice classifies HUMAN regardless of any provider
cases.task: Compile a release-approval requirement with a provider configured.
cases.expected_outcome: It classifies HUMAN, appears as a protected action, and no bounded question is created for it.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan and read the classification and protected actions.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan and its protected action.

cases.title: An unclassifiable requirement is UNRESOLVED, never GENERATIVE
cases.task: Compile a requirement kind the rule table does not declare.
cases.expected_outcome: It classifies UNRESOLVED with UNRESOLVED_CLASSIFICATION and creates no generative need.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan and read the classification and escalation reason.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan and its escalation entry.

cases.title: A compiled plan produces a valid acyclic graph in dependency order
cases.task: Compile a plan with a dependent bounded question and a protected action, then build the graph.
cases.expected_outcome: The graph validates, is acyclic, and the dependent node is not ready until its input succeeds.
cases.evaluation_method: Build the graph from the plan and inspect the execution order and ready nodes.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The graph record and the ready-node sets before and after the input completes.

cases.title: A cycle or a missing dependency is refused at creation
cases.task: Attempt to create a cyclic graph and a graph naming a node that does not exist.
cases.expected_outcome: Both attempts raise a contract error naming the cycle or the missing dependency.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt each creation and read the refusal messages.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two refusal messages.

cases.title: A node cannot succeed without its declared output, and an outcome is immutable
cases.task: Complete a decision-batch node without an answer, then try to rewrite a terminal fact node.
cases.expected_outcome: The output-less success is refused and the terminal outcome cannot be rewritten.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the two transitions and read the refusals.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusal messages.

cases.title: Invalidating an input invalidates every dependent result
cases.task: Complete two dependent nodes, change the input, and invalidate it.
cases.expected_outcome: Both nodes become INVALIDATED, completion is not success, and a running node refuses invalidation.
cases.evaluation_method: Invalidate the completed input and inspect the statuses and graph progress.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The invalidated node ids and the graph progress.

cases.title: A human gate cannot be started, satisfied or bypassed by engine action
cases.task: Attempt to start a human gate, satisfy it with engine evidence, then record a human rejection.
cases.expected_outcome: Both engine attempts are refused; the human rejection is recorded as REFUSED, never success.
cases.evaluation_method: Attempt the engine paths and record the human decision.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refusals and the human decision record.

cases.title: Independent questions over one projection share a single provider call
cases.task: Evaluate two independent bounded questions that share a projection contract and state.
cases.expected_outcome: The provider is called once with both questions, and both answers map back by question id.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the step and read the provider call log and the mapped results.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The call log and the result rows.

cases.title: A dependent question waits for another step instead of sharing a call
cases.task: Plan two questions where the second depends on the first answer.
cases.expected_outcome: The plan has two steps, the dependency edge is recorded, and each step is proven independent.
cases.evaluation_method: Plan the steps and read the step list and the independence check.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The step plan and the dependency check result.

cases.title: Questions that need different projections are separate calls
cases.task: Evaluate one failure-classification question and one review-escalation question.
cases.expected_outcome: Two provider calls are made, one per projection group, and both answers map back.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the step and read the call log.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The call log with both question sets.

cases.title: A missing answer is recorded failed, never mapped to a nearby question
cases.task: Evaluate two questions when the provider only answers one of them.
cases.expected_outcome: The answered question maps to its own answer and the unanswered one is failed; nothing is guessed.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the step and read each result row.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both result rows and the decision records.

cases.title: A cache hit serves the decision without a provider call and preserves provenance
cases.task: Evaluate one bounded question twice against the same state, provider and model version.
cases.expected_outcome: The second evaluation makes no provider call, cites the original decision and keeps its confidence kind.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate twice with a counting provider and compare the two decision records.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two decision records and the provider call log after the first call.

cases.title: A changed projected state misses the cache
cases.task: Cache a decision, then look it up against a different projection digest.
cases.expected_outcome: The lookup misses with reason STATE_CHANGED and no cached answer is served.
cases.evaluation_method: Look the decision up against changed evidence and read the miss reason.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The lookup result and the cache summary.

cases.title: A model version change misses the cache
cases.task: Cache a decision under one concrete model version, then look it up under another.
cases.expected_outcome: The lookup misses with reason MODEL_VERSION_CHANGED; a moving alias is refused outright.
cases.evaluation_method: Look the decision up under a different version and attempt a cache key with an alias.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The miss reason and the alias refusal.

cases.title: A question definition change misses the cache
cases.task: Cache a decision, then look it up with the same question id at a new definition version.
cases.expected_outcome: The lookup misses with reason QUESTION_DEFINITION_CHANGED.
cases.evaluation_method: Change the definition version and read the miss reason.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The miss reason and the two definition digests.

cases.title: A stale, expired or revoked entry is refused, never silently reused
cases.task: Cache a decision with a TTL, expire it, and separately revoke another entry.
cases.expected_outcome: Expiry marks the entry STALE and the lookup refuses it; revocation refuses with reason REVOKED.
cases.evaluation_method: Expire the cache, look up, revoke, and look up again.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The two refusal reasons and the entry freshness.

cases.title: An accepted decision stops the escalation ladder
cases.task: Evaluate a low-consequence question that the provider answers with derived confidence.
cases.expected_outcome: The decision is answered, policy accepts it, and the escalation verdict does not escalate.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate the question and read the escalation verdict.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The decision record and its escalation verdict.

cases.title: Low or missing confidence escalates with a structured reason
cases.task: Refuse a medium-consequence judgement that only carries self-reported confidence, and one with none.
cases.expected_outcome: The verdicts carry LOW_CONFIDENCE and NO_CONFIDENCE, and neither becomes a silent retry.
cases.evaluation_method: Evaluate both questions and read their escalation verdicts.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both decision records and verdicts.

cases.title: An unavailable provider falls back to UNKNOWN and escalates, never crashing
cases.task: Ask an unmapped failure classification with no provider configured.
cases.expected_outcome: The class stays UNKNOWN, the source is fallback-unknown, the decision is recorded as unavailable and the caller is told to escalate.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the integration with the default provider and read the result and decision record.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The result, the decision record status and the escalation reason.

cases.title: A protected operation reaches the human rung regardless of confidence
cases.task: Ask for an escalation verdict on a protected operation with a 0.99 calibrated answer.
cases.expected_outcome: The verdict is POLICY_REQUIRES_HUMAN and the ladder lands on HUMAN.
cases.evaluation_method: Build the record and read the verdict.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The escalation verdict.

cases.title: Stronger options are capability-shaped, never price-ranked
cases.task: List the strengthening options for a refused decision.
cases.expected_outcome: Options name capability mechanisms and carry no price or cost ordering.
cases.evaluation_method: Read the stronger options and check their vocabulary.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The option list.

cases.title: The failure integration never consults a provider for a mapped source
cases.task: Classify a source the declared vocabulary already maps, with a counting provider configured.
cases.expected_outcome: The deterministic class is returned, the source is deterministic and the provider is not called.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the integration with a counting provider and read its call log.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The result and the empty provider call log.

cases.title: Review escalation advice never replaces the review policy
cases.task: Ask for review advice deterministically and through a bounded question.
cases.expected_outcome: Deterministic rules answer where they can; a bounded answer records policy_still_controls and no provider call is wasted.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the advice twice and read the results and call log.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: Both advice results and the provider call log.

cases.title: Evidence relevance never overrides freshness or provenance
cases.task: Ask about stale evidence, evidence without provenance, and fresh evidence, with a provider that would always say SUPPORTS.
cases.expected_outcome: Stale answers IRRELEVANT and provenance-free answers UNKNOWN deterministically; only the fresh claim reaches the provider.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the integration three times and read the answers and call log.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three answers and the provider call log.

cases.title: Routing advice resolves known structure deterministically and protects human policy
cases.task: Ask for a route family for a declared implementation kind, an unknown kind, and a protected operation.
cases.expected_outcome: Declared kinds resolve without a call, an unknown kind may be bounded, and a protected operation stays unknown with policy authority.
cases.evaluation_method: Call the advice three times and read the families and call log.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The three advice results and the call log.

cases.title: Decision economics count calls, avoidance and cache reuse from records
cases.task: Compile a mixed plan, resolve a bounded question, reuse it, and read the economics.
cases.expected_outcome: Avoided deterministic calls, provider calls, cache reuses and questions per batch are all reported without fabricated money.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the flow and read the intelligence economics.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The economics view and the underlying records.

cases.title: The compiled-plan comparison is structural and claims no quality parity
cases.task: Compare an old execution plan with the decision-compiled plan for a compiled task.
cases.expected_outcome: Model calls, decision calls, state bytes, stages and workers are reported with explicit deltas and a claim boundary.
cases.evaluation_method: Build the comparison and read the deltas and boundary.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The comparison document.

cases.title: Bounded decisions are counted as avoided generative calls, structurally
cases.task: Compile a plan with a bounded question and read the avoidance counts.
cases.expected_outcome: The bounded question is counted once as an avoided generative call and no monetary figure is produced.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan and read its economics block.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan economics block.

cases.title: D1: an exact fact never becomes a decision or a model call
cases.task: Compile and resolve a task whose only requirement code can establish exactly.
cases.expected_outcome: No bounded question, no provider call, no generation; the fast path applies.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the plan, run the deterministic integration path and read every counter.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The plan, the provider call log and the fast-path verdict.

cases.title: D2: an ambiguous failure becomes one bounded judgement, one repair, one verification
cases.task: Classify an unmapped failure with a deterministic provider, act on the accepted class, and record the verification.
cases.expected_outcome: A ChoiceDecision produces the class, policy accepts it, the action cites the decision and the verification follows it in the trace.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the flow and read the decision, the action edge, the verification and the trace.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The decision record, the action fields, the verification record and the trace steps.

cases.title: D3: a low-confidence bounded decision escalates to a stronger path
cases.task: Ask a medium-consequence question answered with self-reported confidence, then list the stronger options.
cases.expected_outcome: Policy refuses it, the ladder names LOW_CONFIDENCE and a stronger mechanism, and the options are capability-shaped.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the flow and read the refusal, the escalation verdict and the options.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The refused decision, the escalation verdict and the stronger options.

cases.title: D4: a high-confidence decision on a protected operation still needs the human gate
cases.task: Answer a protected operation question with 0.99 calibrated confidence and run the graph to its human gate.
cases.expected_outcome: Policy refuses to authorize, the escalation lands on HUMAN, and the graph awaits rather than completing.
cases.evaluation_method: Compile the protected task, evaluate the would-be decision, build the graph and read the boundary.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The policy verdict, the escalation verdict and the graph boundary.

cases.title: D5: a cached decision is reused only while the state is identical
cases.task: Answer a question, reuse it, change the relevant evidence, and separately revoke it.
cases.expected_outcome: The identical state reuses without a call; a relevant state change misses; a revocation refuses.
cases.evaluation_method: Run the flow and read the two decision ids, the miss reason and the revocation reason.
cases.evidence_required_for_success: The reuse record, the miss reason and the revocation reason.
